name: North Newton (United States)
description: Vertical bicolour of brown and orange, charged with a sunflower whose petals double as a compass rose, in counterchanged colours.
history: North Newton is a city in Harvey County, Kansas. The flag was adopted in 2024 (the design by Blayne Stump, winner of a flag contest sponsored by Conrade Insurance, was declared at the city council meeting of 15 October 2024 after a residents' vote among sixteen designs, according to Flags of the World).
